mathematics.conventions: Fine weighted mass diag(1/6,1/6,1/3,1/3); coarse coordinates (u_A,u_B,u_C,r) with common mass factor 1/3.
inputs: One connected four-state path with edge energy coefficients 1,1/2,1 and specified partition.

No parameter scan or continuum approximation is performed.
